diagnostics.message: The runners module creates Lambda functions that may be invoked against the VPC before the VPC module's AWS networking resources have finished provisioning. The module input references establish a dependency on module.base:output.vpc, but the resource-group resource is independent and can be applied concurrently; if that resource-group inventory is intended to include the runner infrastructure, add an explicit ordering dependency. Source does not otherwise establish that intent, so no diagnostic is warranted for this pair.

The explicit depends_on from module.runners.module.runner_binaries:resource.aws_s3_bucket_notification.on_deploy to module.runners.module.runner_binaries:resource.aws_lambda_permission.on_deploy is redundant: the notification's lambda_function_arn reference to the syncer Lambda only covers function creation, but source contains explicit depends_on to permission. Wait: not redundant because no reference to permission. Do not report.
